title: Have your coding agent edit and schedule your reels
summary: A small Facebook creator asked Claude Code to start editing his videos, then let it edit and schedule the very reel announcing that request.
agent_role: Claude Code edited the recorded video and scheduled it for posting. The creator filmed the clip and gave the instruction.
what_they_did: The poster had about 180 Facebook followers and around 200 views per reel. He filmed a quick clip of himself asking Claude Code to start editing his videos. He then let Claude Code edit that clip and schedule it.
prompt: Edit the video at [video file path] into a short reel for [platform]. Cut silences and filler words, add readable captions, and keep it under [length] seconds. Show me the edited version first. Once I approve, prepare it for posting at [date and time] on [my account], but confirm with me before actually scheduling it.

curation.rationale: A real agent use (Claude Code editing and scheduling a video), but the post is a teaser with no result or method details.
